name: Procurement and stores
description: Suppliers, stock items and stock levels per store, requests for quotation with recorded quotations and award, budgets per cost centre, purchase requests with approval (a budget approval from 5000, and a tenant-administrator approval when the cost centre budget would be exceeded), purchase orders as internal records, goods receipts, stock issues (also parts used on work orders) and automatic replenishment. Nothing is sent to suppliers.

roles.name: Procurement officer
roles.description: Maintains suppliers and the item catalogue, reviews purchase requests

roles.name: Storekeeper
roles.description: Receives goods, issues stock and records stock counts

roles.name: Budget holder
roles.description: Approves purchase requests of 5000 or more

changes: Requests for quotation, quotations and award
Budgets per cost centre; a request that would exceed the budget needs a tenant-administrator approval
Parts used on work orders are booked out of stores
lifecycle.on_deactivate: The procurement capability is withdrawn: requests, orders, receipts and stock records are kept but can no longer be changed. Approvals that finish while it is off issue no purchase order.
